int ifElse(bool a) {
  if (a) {
    return 1;
  } else {
    return 2;
  }
}

int ifNoElse(bool a) {
  var x = 0;
  if (a) {
    x = 1;
  }
  return x;
}

int earlyReturn(bool a) {
  if (!a) return 0;
  return 1;
}

int ternary(bool a) {
  return a ? 1 : 2;
}

int ternaryMultiline(bool a) {
  return a
      ? 1
      : 2;
}

bool andOp(bool a, bool b) {
  return a && b;
}

bool orOp(bool a, bool b) {
  return a || b;
}

int nullCoalesce(int? a) {
  return a ?? 7;
}

int nullCoalesceCall(int? a) {
  return a ?? fallback();
}

int fallback() => 7;

int? nullAware(String? s) {
  return s?.length;
}

int switchStmt(int a) {
  switch (a) {
    case 1:
      return 10;
    case 2:
      return 20;
    default:
      return 30;
  }
}

int switchExpr(int a) {
  return switch (a) {
    1 => 10,
    2 => 20,
    _ => 30,
  };
}

int forLoop(int n) {
  var s = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    s += i;
  }
  return s;
}

int whileLoop(int n) {
  var s = 0;
  while (n > 0) {
    s += n;
    n--;
  }
  return s;
}

int forIn(List<int> xs) {
  var s = 0;
  for (final x in xs) {
    s += x;
  }
  return s;
}

int tryCatch(bool a) {
  try {
    if (a) throw StateError('x');
    return 1;
  } catch (_) {
    return 2;
  }
}

int oneLineIfElse(bool a) { if (a) { return 1; } else { return 2; } }

int defaultParam([int a = 3]) => a;

int notCalled(bool a) {
  if (a) {
    return 1;
  }
  return 2;
}

int noBranch(int a) {
  return a + 1;
}

int elseIf(int a) {
  if (a == 1) {
    return 1;
  } else if (a == 2) {
    return 2;
  }
  return 3;
}

class Money {
  Money(this.cents);
  final int cents;
  bool get isZero => cents == 0;
  Money add(Money o) => Money(cents + o.cents);
}

const answer = 42;
